coverage.reading: Every episode and index listed below, and every H2 in treatments 001-048, was read to its end with HTML comments masked. The truncated combined output for screenplay 003 and treatment 010 was replaced by a full separate read before classification.

method.four_parent_tests: Copied wording/imagery, explanatory labels, narrator/design statements, borrowed opening/action sequence, in that order. Dash means no candidate identified; Y is an initial yes. A whole borrowed run can fail while its short utterances remain independently permissible.
method.parent_scope: Each paragraph was compared with its unit actual parent H2 set, all read in full. Actual links are retained per H2. Author commentary was compared with the union of episode parents. This is set-level lineage, not a claim that every listed parent is the exact semantic source of every paragraph. Exact passages accompany positive candidates.
method.segmentation: Every nonblank, non-heading, non-parent source line is a paragraph. Terminal punctuation before an uppercase/quote start separates sentence locators; a.m./p.m. and common titles are protected. Caption fragments and index links are inspected rows too. Original source line and character spans define exact locations despite ambiguous linguistic sentence boundaries.
method.judgment: The reader completed the full body and parent reading before choosing repairs or generating this record. Code constructs locators and transfers that reading. It does not infer no from search absence, similarity scores or unread default text. A dash is an initial no for applicable named failures, not proof of approval.
method.applicable_families: C,S,F,N,W as applicable; R for script execution or inherited execution clarity; A,U for final screenplay; P for paragraph comparisons. Metadata has structural inspection rather than scene-language duties.
method.decision_rule: Unresolved named failures on initial text remain yes candidates. Certainty explicitly separates them from clear findings. No revised text is classified here.
limits: A single isolated textual classification is not independent approval, measured performance or media observation.
The locator split is reproducible, but not a proof of linguistic sentence boundaries.
Negative paragraph comparisons use the actual parent H2 set; their exact one-to-one semantic provenance is not independently established.

Additional precise dates or appearance values absent from immediate parent prose were inventoried separately as unresolved lineage, not pronounced false without their canonical owners. Settings bodies and source archives were not read.
A complete table records coverage; it cannot guarantee error-free subjective judgments.

The reading compared inherited names, chronology, states and uncertainty against the actual parent prose, but this record does not contain an exhaustive separate per-value inventory. The unresolved-value list is a candidate list, not proof of full value-inventory coverage.

findings.quote: LANNES: Do you think the insult vanishes because there is work to do?
findings.reason: The required insult has become a question about whether an insult vanishes.
findings.exception_test: Reconstruction permits fresh words; it must preserve the inherited speech act.

parent.passage: Soult replies that there are more important matters that day, and Lannes answers with an insult.

findings.quote: LANNES: And that makes what happened disappear?
findings.reason: The same inherited insult is replaced by a rhetorical question.
findings.exception_test: Short utterances may remain, but that does not restore an absent speech act.

parent.passage: Soult replies that there are more important matters that day, and Lannes answers with an insult.

findings.quote: A young body in a larger space.
findings.reason: Neither the used space, contrastive scale nor an operation is given.
findings.exception_test: Restrained detail is valid; this still leaves the proposed image unspecified.

parent.passage: Indoors in daytime, an older boy closes a book.

findings.quote: Saliceti's authority opens the assignment, and Napoleon positions guns in the field.
findings.reason: The first clause states the meaning already carried by the accepted assignment and following signing/hauling relation.
findings.exception_test: Keep the useful hand-to-gun image relation; it does not require this first clause.

parent.passage: A signed paper leaves the desk.

findings.quote: He decides between waiting to commit them together and continuing the attack now.
findings.reason: The unvoiced alternatives repeat the absent cavalry, report and immediately following order.
findings.exception_test: Motivation-setting speech is protected; this adds neither motive nor operation.

parent.passage: NAPOLEON: Continue the attack.

findings.quote: As Napoleon looks for his name after victory, the caption changes to Cairo.
findings.reason: Looking for his name turns the concrete search for Desaix into an unclear object of sight.
findings.exception_test: Poetic expression still needs a legible image.

parent.passage: Search for Desaix among returning men. The gaze stops on his body.

findings.quote: Without opening the vote, the president leaves the chamber.
findings.reason: The scene fixes departure before the guards appeal where the parent explicitly leaves its order unfixed.
findings.exception_test: Useful movement cannot silently resolve inherited uncertainty.

parent.passage: Do not fix the order of Lucien's departure from the chair, the exact words of his appeal, or an oath with a drawn sword.

findings.quote: Secretary Bourrienne rolls up the sleeves of his black wool coat and writes the answer.
findings.reason: The run imports the particular wait/clarify/read back/transmit/call/admit execution.
findings.exception_test: Names, functions and short replies may survive; they do not protect the whole chosen sequence.

parent.passage: BOURRIENNE: Shall I tell him to go home today, or wait until you call him?

findings.quote: Life ends within reach of his hand.
findings.reason: An unclear spatial metaphor replaces a legible prisoner death or bodily operation.
findings.exception_test: Restrained death and a date caption are valid; the extra metaphor adds no identifiable operation.

parent.passage: Time passes in confinement. Caption: April 7, 1803.

findings.quote: Benefits and restrictions seen earlier now lie in the same framework to be applied to many people.
findings.reason: The unperformed framework sentence restates the displayed clauses and completed code.
findings.exception_test: Keep necessary legal terms and captions; this statement is neither.

parent.passage: A society gains protection of property and legal equality, but also receives the subordination of women and children and control of labor within the same order.

findings.quote: Russian command also calculates the army left.
findings.reason: Calculate the army left is an awkward verb/object combination for assessing remaining strength.
findings.exception_test: Formal military language remains, with an idiomatic object.

parent.passage: Alexander too must protect his army and country's strength, so fighting continues.

findings.quote: A different corps behind counterattacks, but cannot reverse the result of the fight already broken.
findings.reason: The fight already broken is an unclear translated combination.
findings.exception_test: Concise battle connections are valid; the English combination is the issue.

parent.passage: A separate corps then counterattacks but cannot reverse the defeat already inflicted.

findings.quote: Charles's victory and the limits confronting the French remain.
findings.reason: The sentence names the conclusion already carried by the stopped attack and withdrawal.
findings.exception_test: Useful exit staging is allowed; this supplies interpretation alone.

parent.passage: The audience receives both the tension of Napoleon seeking a way to win and the reversal in which the man who earlier divided enemies is now bound by the river and connection to his own army.

findings.quote: There was time spent waiting after the day he was wounded.
findings.reason: Unlike the death date, this sentence repeats the preceding treatment and another day's waiting.
findings.exception_test: Adopted narration must add judgment, irony, cost or anticipation unavailable through the scene.

parent.passage: Daylight on another day. Napoleon comes to the bed and starts to speak, then stops at labored breathing.

findings.quote: Place the Pope's temporal territory, neutrality, and religious authority alongside territorial and blockade control demanded by the empire.
findings.reason: Abstract categories are placed alongside one another without an image, sound or operation, then repeated by the historian.
findings.exception_test: Necessary concise historical context may use narration; this extra inventory is unperformed.

parent.passage: The earlier Concordat sustained religious life and gained support for rule, but imperial control and blockade demanded by Napoleon clash with the Pope's temporal territory, religious authority, and neutrality.

findings.quote: He adjusts his hands as he takes the baby.
findings.reason: The childcare run imports the mother instructs/father adjusts/baby moves/checking reply/mother rests sequence and hand imagery.
findings.exception_test: Birth, joy, recovery and short replies remain; they do not require this whole execution.

parent.passage: She shows him where to support the baby.

findings.quote: The weaver watches Napoleon and waits for more.
findings.reason: The unanswered wait, return and resumed weaving imports the script's particular closing operation.
findings.exception_test: The employment outcome must remain open; that result does not require this same closing sequence.

parent.passage: The weaver waits for another answer, then adjusts the cards and resumes.

findings.quote: First-name caption: Bourgogne, Guard infantry sergeant.
findings.reason: First-name caption names a first-appearance identifier, while Bourgogne is not presented as a given name.
findings.exception_test: The first-entry identification itself is useful and protected.

parent.passage: Bourgogne has the perspective of marching and survival.

findings.quote: MESSENGER: A demand for a new army.
findings.reason: In a family house the message labels a state-level purpose instead of delivering the household's demand.
findings.exception_test: Institutional words are permitted but must fit the recipient and immediate act.

parent.passage: Loss becomes the need for new conscription, horses, and equipment and reaches French homes again.

findings.quote: CONSCRIPT: When the money comes, is it finished?
findings.reason: The question fabricates money finishing a recruit's obligations so the reply can teach that he must march.
findings.exception_test: Bureaucratic humor or inexperience may work, but no particular belief or tactic is established beyond the lesson.

parent.passage: Allies prepare recruits and equipment while awaiting support, so a promise alone does not complete an army.

findings.quote: Beside the conditional succession proposal, military possibility disappears.
findings.reason: The sentence states a result already performed by corps news and the following unconditional document.
findings.exception_test: Concise connections are allowed; this repeats adjacent operations.

parent.passage: News of the defection closes the military possibility on which conditional succession could rely.

findings.quote: NAPOLEON: There is discontent with the Restoration in France. I will look at other news too.
findings.reason: The speech reads out the news and announces the immediately following comparison, without a listener or tactic.
findings.exception_test: Motivation-setting speech is protected, but this adds no new motive or understanding.

parent.passage: Napoleon, unable to summon family at will, reads discontent about the French Restoration.

findings.quote: It was not a choice that put down his responsibility for his family's life.
findings.reason: Put down his responsibility is an unnatural combination.
findings.exception_test: The historian's family-cost judgment is functional; recompose it rather than delete it.

parent.passage: Introduce Bertrand as a man with both responsibility for following the Emperor again and a family life.

findings.quote: The face that sought to protect the army when he stopped the Emperor's march before now faces a different choice.
findings.reason: The sentence interprets the earlier face and announces the new choice before Ney states it.
findings.exception_test: Changed motivation must remain; an unvoiced explanation is not its present performance.

parent.passage: NEY: Then I stopped to protect the army. Now this paper cannot hold those turning away.

findings.quote: The Emperor's military confidence cannot erase those conditions.
findings.reason: After argument and repeated Act captions the sentence states their conclusion without a speaker or new image.
findings.exception_test: Authority may operate through general speech, but this has no speaker.

parent.passage: LUCIEN: An army's return is not a blank check from the country.

findings.quote: He judges within his conditional report that he would follow if the enemy went to Wavre and yesterday's mission.
findings.reason: Judges within his conditional report is management language and a tangled relation rather than realized access.
findings.exception_test: Keep the knowledge boundary through useful text, action or narration.

parent.passage: At that moment he has the previous day's mission to pursue the Prussians and the divided state of their march he has confirmed and reported; he has not yet received the new dispatches that will reach him later that day.

findings.quote: He stays on that direction a little longer, then turns toward troops fighting now.
findings.reason: Stays on that direction is not idiomatic for maintaining his gaze.
findings.exception_test: The meaningful wait and gaze direction must survive.

parent.passage: He looks down the road Grouchy should take.

findings.quote: O'MEARA: When did this begin today?
findings.reason: The answer It is worse than before answers severity rather than onset; no neighboring response addresses that mismatch.
findings.exception_test: Evasion or confusion could function if established; neither is shown here.

parent.passage: O'Meara still sees and treats the patient closely.

findings.quote: The adopted cause of death is stomach cancer.
findings.reason: Adopted places the production's canon-selection word in actual historian speech.
findings.exception_test: Documentary qualification is legitimate; the production act of adoption is not its world-facing wording.

parent.passage: Distinguish stomach cancer adopted as cause of death from differences in contemporary diagnosis; do not open arsenic poisoning as a factual event or mystery with a hidden culprit.

findings.quote: The child once promising a return did not become a living successor who could return.
findings.reason: The unvoiced closing conclusion repeats missing power and death just performed.
findings.exception_test: Preserve the loss; a repeated unperformed conclusion does not add it.

parent.passage: What remains for the audience is not a promise of a future emperor but the result that neither father nor son could return.

findings.quote: This was not a place to confirm a person had returned alive.
findings.reason: No preceding image suggests living return; the historian voices a prohibition against an invented misunderstanding.
findings.exception_test: Adopted irony or cost may qualify, but the coffin scene already honors this prohibition.

parent.passage: Do not write it as a miracle in which an undamaged hero returns to life.

findings.quote: Las Cases translates and conveys language and records in his own notebook.
findings.reason: Translates and conveys language confuses the conveyed content with its medium; records also has an unclear coordinated object.
findings.exception_test: His practical language and record role is necessary; make its action clear.

parent.passage: Las Cases uses language and recording to connect requests.

findings.quote: Watch a life gradually losing strength to continue walking, eating, and speaking.
findings.reason: The sentence summarizes losses just performed by the stopped walk, diminished meal and shortened dictation.
findings.exception_test: The bodily process is essential, but the adjacent actions already realize it.

parent.passage: Garden, dictation, meals, and rest are not a simple exile montage, but a daily life changing the scope of what can be done that day.

findings.quote: As he seeks his place attached to his father's name, there is no French state or army given to him.
findings.reason: An unperformed abstract explanation sits between the private question, bodily action and historian's explicit statement that he never ruled.
findings.exception_test: Necessary context may use adopted narration; the neighboring historian already states the limiting fact.

parent.passage: Even if desires arise to remain with family and to ask about his father's place, nominal status gives him no actual state or army.

findings.quote: Gourgaud waits for the exchange, then raises what he prepared to say.
findings.reason: Raises what he prepared to say is an awkward combination for trying to speak or introduce a matter.
findings.exception_test: The interrupted attempt and competitive waiting remain; the combination needs repair.

parent.passage: GOURGAUD: I have something to tell you too.

Short utterance, propaganda satire, soldier pride and bodily cost. Recompose a failed surrounding sequence without losing the joke.

Living together and letting me live are different things.
A pointed interpersonal demand, not automatically a failed balanced summary.
scripts/009#constitution
An army's return is not a blank check from the country.
Answers the immediately preceding military claim within concrete tax and ministerial limits; general authority statements may function.
screenplay/001#night
no intelligible lyrics
Useful audience-access and source boundary; technical prohibitions are not automatically jargon.
screenplay/005#blockade
In each region, after movement evading inspection, the next inspection becomes stricter.
The event parent explicitly adopts this enforcement/evasion cycle. Geographical recurrence and different groups were considered; frequency alone did not create a yes.
screenplay/010#ending
The coffin does not move.
Meaningful final stillness, not manufactured silence.
scripts/010#ending
The state received him.
With Bertrand and the coffin this can mark state reception against individual loss in the adopted narrator voice; no yes was assigned merely because it is a general final sentence.
